record.question: The Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) 1956 classified industries into three categories. Which of the following correctly describes 'Schedule B' industries?
options: Industries exclusively owned by the state.
Industries left entirely to the private sector without government interference.
Industries which would be progressively state-owned, but private enterprise could supplement state effort.
Industries reserved for the Small Scale Sector (SSI) only.
